notes: A fresh look: calmer colours for Fix, Change and Remember, a truly black dark mode, and lime play buttons that glow and morph smoothly.
Hover to learn: rest the pointer on any button and a small tip explains what it does, with its shortcut.
Smoother controls: highlights slide between tools, tabs and filters; messages arrive as small banners you can close; the time readout, speed and Loop now sit in one tidy toolbar.
Better sound previews: sounds and music fill their waveform as they play, and you can drag along a music track to hear any part of it.
New in the Library: a Follow + comment outro, and a keyboard shortcuts sheet with keys you can press.
